ask: Eamon, 11-Sep: 'widen metrics and parameters until you find an edge for it'
bar: A cell is an EDGE iff it survives BH at FDR 0.05 across all m=152 pre-declared cells on the day-clustered one-sided paired-difference t, AND its selection-adjusted p_max <= 0.05 against the shift-placebo max statistic, AND it survives coin-clustering, AND it passes every concentration test, AND its point excess exceeds its own mde80_cluster. Even then it ships only as a shadow-lane restriction with a pre-registered forward read, never as a live change.
refusal: The search is a REFUSAL iff no cell meets that conjunction. It is reported with the best cell's excess, its p_max, and the smallest cluster-adjusted mde80 across the tested cells — it names what could NOT have been seen; it does not claim the book has no edge.
